assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only re-zero:julius-juukulius@light-novel#character-model, the canonical derived-use model REZERO_JULIUS_JUUKULIUS_V01_V16_CHARACTER_MODEL.md at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the original Japanese main light novels V01-V16, whose load-bearing Julius evidence is V04, V07, V08, V09 and V16. The project's CURRENT_STATE_AND_CORPUS_MAP.md and 05 Character Analysis README were read for method, authority order and scope only. The separate same-analyst fidelity review, the frozen volume readings, the master and five owner ledgers, the reconstruction protocol, the source lock and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them. The model's MONOGRAPH_READY and PASS_WITH_BOUND labels and its HIGH and MEDIUM confidence tags are inputs, not conclusions. No V17 or later volume, EX, IF, web-novel, anime or game material is included, and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Julius's phases from the V04 court encounter, duel and private accountability (J04) through the V07 qualified apology and Yuri aid (J07), the living and terminal V08 operation (J08O, J08T), the depicted V09 renewed council, shared-sense battle and aftermath (J09) and the V16 peer, ordinary and private scenes (J16), with the model's default being the latest personally observed V16 garden conversation after the disrupted meal and before the park (p-017#B0423-0430). The terminal J08T state is usable only as an explicitly selected discarded state. V05, V06 and V10-V15 supply no Julius bundles, so development across that interval is observed only in its V16 result. The declared horizon is V16; his location and receipt at E019 and in V17, which the project has since admitted, are expressly not established. No in-world calendar dates are fixed and the exact timing of the late V09 conversations is unmarked.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: Section 1's thesis (making care answerable to a publicly intelligible role, with the harm done when dignity measures another person's standing), twenty-four eight-field conditional rules with exceptions, section 4's knowledge firewall and section 10's four rejected rival readings with a mixed model and named revision triggers form a rule-level inferential structure on thirty-two located bundles. Counterweights: a single same-analyst artifact built on five volumes; Julius is seen through Subaru's narration; the model leaves what he still endorses of the court doctrine, his complete duel motives and his private reasons for disclosures partly open.

Section 2's seven-axis table and six phase selectors (J04, J07, J08O, J08T, J09, J16) bind each phase to its event state and forbid carrying later friendship, voice flexibility or received criticism back into V04, while section 4 tables what each phase's Julius can know. The trajectory from class challenge to qualified apology, entrusted perception and private reciprocity is located at four points, but V10-V15 are unobserved, late V09 timing is unmarked and the horizon ends at V16 while the project spine is V17.

Section 7 records eleven located short forms with loci and operational readings: エミリア様, 私 and 君, 美しくない, 拝命しました, the ユーリ alias, 精霊騎士 and 蕾, 貴様 beside スバル in the possession appeal, 我が友 at the trust scene, お言葉ですが opening a jurisdiction refusal, the repeated 心まで鎧を that Subaru authored, and 嗜み. It instructs selecting speaker, recipient, office, audience and pressure before imitation and describing a speech strategy rather than claiming exact wording where the source is silent. No sentence-final inventory, frequency data or extended-speech model exists.

Section 6 gives ten ordinary rows, mostly single V16 observations: hair-adjusting and polished dress, finishing Anastasia's burned food before a tactful request, praising her kimono, the flexibility split, professed musical cultivation, the floor-care correction for inn staff, accepting Ferris's treatment and concern for Joshua, plus V07 teasing. Favorite food, books, genre, training hours, spending and a normal day away from duty are named SOURCE_SILENT.

Section 5 conditions the decision by recipient: Subaru across four phases from insulting claimant to entrusted perceiver and criticizing friend; Anastasia's face-preserving service and tactful correction; Reinhard's humiliation and reported obedience; Joshua's frailty; the spirits as partners he will not discard; Ferris's shared coordination but divergent terminal response; Marcos's accepted discipline and Heinkel's unbinding rank, with matched-recipient contrasts on the same low-stakes problem. Julius-side only; Joshua and Heinkel rest on one scene each and inner access to any recipient is denied.

Interior evidence is self-report in located scenes: accepting blame and naming private resentment in the V04 accountability (E08), the explicit nonretraction inside the apology (E12), asking whether the man he hurt can trust him (E18), the private thanks and accepted sting of the heart-in-armor image (E30) and regret about hearsay (E31). Julius is not focalized, his complete duel motives and doctrine endorsement remain underdetermined, and the model supplies no interior model beyond those scenes.

Rules R01-R04, R09, R10, R13-R15 and R20 cover the class challenge and coercive lesson with its accepted discipline, the surprise counter, the refusal to discard spirits, the refused then enacted lethal act in the terminal branch, the eye-closure entrustment, the wall counterexample, the nonlethal host trap and the polite jurisdiction refusal, each with an adverse case (E05-E08 excess and injury, E16 steel). Post-V16 conflict and any other possession condition are outside the set.

Moral positions are argued in his own words: pointing to Emilia's face against care that hurts its recipient (E04), the apology that explicitly does not retract his doctrine (E12), refusing to abandon his spirits (E15), objecting to the lethal request on obligation and unfinished talk (E16), asking for trust without demanding forgiveness (E18), the jurisdiction refusal (E29) and grading his own hearsay (E31). The model gives no general deliberation procedure, leaves the court doctrine partly endorsed and forbids reading intent as erasure of harm.

The misfiring dragon and injury joke, the transparent Yuri fiction and its V16 recall, prospective celebration teasing while wounded, the flexibility contest and the music exchange are located (E09, E23, E32), and rule R23 treats bounded play as a way through an awkward mood with MEDIUM unfamiliar transfer. Instances are few, mostly V07 and V16, and the only exact quoted form is the alias.

Section 3 fixes five locked Japanese witnesses by SHA-256 and section 14 states twenty-three bounded deliveries across V04, V07, V08, V09 and V16, 1,907 text positions, explicitly not five fresh complete rereads. V05, V06 and V10-V15 are not revisited, the corpus label is a horizon rather than an appearance claim, and the declared V16 horizon excludes the project's later admitted volume and the separate review.

Twenty-six negative controls, four rejected rival readings with the mixed model's revision triggers, the actual excess and five-day suspension of the duel (E06, E08), the explicit nonretraction (E12), the terminal steel at the dying neck (E16), the stone-enabled wall breach that limits the all-cutting rhetoric (E21), the immediate regret about hearsay (E31) and NC02's rule that intent does not erase harm are affirmative, located constraints. All sit inside one artifact with the project's own review.

Phases are bound to E008, E011 and its death, E012, E013 and the pre-E019 default; terminal and living operations are separated; NC08 and NC10 deny successor recall of the terminal killing and its replay; the default is fixed to the last observed garden rather than an invented E019 reaction, and section 4 tables availability per selection. Late V09 timing, the V10-V15 gap and the V17 spine lag bound it.

conditions: Written Japanese register only, as section 7 defines it; no anime delivery, prosody or audiovisual staging.

Speaker, recipient, office, audience and pressure are selected before lexical imitation, with the address the model supports for that relation and phase (エミリア様 in public, 我が友 only from the V09 trust scene onward, the familiar name only after the V07 apology).

Polish is not rendered as automatic coldness, no archaic flourish or repeated catchphrase is invented, and where the source has not supplied the expression a speech strategy is described instead of exact wording.
Unfamiliar modern vocabulary is asked about or narrowed rather than known.
Output is noncanonical reconstruction output and is never cited as evidence.
scenario_readiness.note: The forms are located and recipient-conditioned but few; the model itself generates no canon dialogue.

conditions: Chronology is one named phase, by default the V16 garden before the park; no E019, V17 or later, EX, IF, web-novel or anime state is used, and the horizon is stated.
Knowledge is limited to section 4: no RBD, witch encounter, terminal E011 recall, full receipt of Subaru's loops, the lost square or an observed current location.

The interlocutor is an attested recipient in an attested relation; a stranger or unfamiliar audience does not inherit the peer's intimacy or the private disclosure route, and the exact unfamiliar response is left UNDERDETERMINED where the model says so.

The situation matches the classes the twelve applications and the rules cover (imperfect meal, family rumor, official threat, danger detection, pursuit while depleted, unwanted protection, teasing about bearing, abandoning a partner, reassurance after error, a modern invitation); output is a behavioral tendency with the model's HIGH or MEDIUM label, and a question the source does not stage ends in abstention.
No readiness is inherited from the model's MONOGRAPH_READY or PASS_WITH_BOUND labels.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named V04-V16 phase, by default the latest personally observed V16 garden conversation after the disrupted meal and before Subaru's park continuation (J16); earlier phases, including the terminal J08T branch, only when explicitly selected with their own knowledge, remembered history, recipient, role and resources.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Subaru, Anastasia, Reinhard, Joshua, his spirits, Emilia, Ferris, Marcos, Heinkel or a possessing enemy, each as a distinct person in its attested phase; strangers only under R24 with abstention on intimacy, jurisdiction and received knowledge.
setting_constraints: The royal Guard and court, the candidate camps' councils, the Whale and Sloth operations with Nect, and the V16 inn meal and garden as narrated
No crossover institution, technology or cultural assumption outside the V01-V16 corpus; modern and Earth references are unfamiliar
Sword and spirit capacities follow the demonstrated conditions: trained skill, partners, mana cost, injury and the wall counterexample; no universal immunity or all-cutting power
KNOWLEDGE_STATE_UNKNOWN, ENDPOINT_NOT_YET_READ, ORDINARY_LIFE_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT and INTERNAL_MOTIVE_UNDERDETERMINED end in abstention

scenario_readiness.note: Section 12 supplies twelve noncanonical applications with matched contrasts as an application protocol, but they were assessed only by the same analyst's nonblind documentary review, which lies outside this evidence set.

scenario_readiness.note: Section 6 supports a modest ordinary baseline, mostly from single V16 scenes, with explicit unknowns.

conditions: Only the attested classes: qualification and honor versus care that hurts its recipient, accountability for a coercive lesson, loyalty to spirit partners, a lethal request against obligation, trust after injury, unwanted protection, present jurisdiction and graded disclosure of private information.
Intent never erases harm, the V04 class doctrine is neither renounced nor repeated unchanged, and acceptance of criticism does not guarantee improved conduct.
A dilemma the source does not stage, and any question of what he still endorses, ends in abstention.
scenario_readiness.note: Positions are argued in his own words across several scenes, but the model supplies no general procedure and leaves the doctrine question open.

Controls NC16 and NC19 mark romantic interpretation as not textually resolved: Anastasia's courtesy and the spirit affection are not romance, no romantic exchange is staged and private romantic history is SOURCE_SILENT. Located constraints exist, so the scenario is assessed and found unsupported rather than unassessed.

conditions: Attested roles only: Guard knight under Marcos's discipline, Anastasia's first knight with the overt Yuri workaround, Spirit Knight with six developing partners, and special-duty knight refusing an out-of-jurisdiction order.

Capacity follows the demonstrated conditions: trained skill with injury, mana exhaustion and need for treatment; Nect requires actual ability, support, risk and assent; no immunity to every mental effect.
Rank is real but not every order binds, and respectful address can coexist with refusal; no coup, universal obedience or complete alliance authority is supplied.
scenario_readiness.note: Guard, candidate-knight and Spirit Knight conduct is the best-evidenced domain, with section 8 separating competence from pressure and failure.

known_limits.statement: The model declares its horizon as V01-V16 and its default as the last observed V16 garden, states that Julius's location and receipt at E019 are unshown and returns ENDPOINT_NOT_YET_READ or KNOWLEDGE_STATE_UNKNOWN for later questions; the project's admitted spine has since reached V17, so the default is the end of this evidence set, not the continuity's latest state.

The model records its fidelity state as PASS_WITH_BOUND, same analyst, nonblind, documentary, with no independent, held-out, runtime or global grade, and sets do_not_use_as_primary_literary_authority to true as a derived-use artifact subordinate to the frozen readings, the ledgers and the Japanese source.

Load-bearing evidence comes from V04, V07, V08, V09 and V16 only; the model states that V05, V06 and V10-V15 are not revisited and that the range does not establish an exhaustive childhood, family history or diary, so the change between the V09 trust scene and the V16 reciprocity is observed in its result, not its process.

What Julius still endorses of the V04 station and lineage doctrine, his complete duel motives, his full family history and his private reasons for every disclosure remain underdetermined in the model's own terms; the avoided lethal retaliation is an assessed possibility, not an observed alternative, and intent does not erase the injury he inflicted.

Successor Julius does not retain the terminal E011 killing, Subaru received only part of the private V04 accountability, Nect was released before the witch scene and supplies no RBD or thought access, and modern vocabulary is unfamiliar; section 4 governs what each phase's Julius can know.

The separate fidelity review, the frozen readings, the ledgers, the protocol and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated on this subject, and the project's later admitted V17 lies outside this set; none was used, and missing support is not evidence of absence.
